Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the low pressure 
feed water pump inspection steps I1, which must be carried out on a monthly 
bases as indicated by M1 in the title block
The pump technical data:
 Type: 
single stage centrifugal pump 
 R.P.M : 2900
 No of stage : One stage Power 
: 37 K W
 Suction press. : 1.8 
bar Max .flow : 80 m3/ h
 Discharge press. : 9.5 bar
The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed 
Taha El Mansy , tested by eng. Abdel Qader Fath Alla at 30 May 2003 
on Module 1 pump no. A and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir 
Abdel Gilel, accepted by general director eng. Sobhy Mohamed El Bakry 
and approved by eng. Moneer Mohamed El Wakeel Head Sector 
of Demietta PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
Shut down the pump.
Disconnect the power 
 supply & rack out the c.b
Put red tag on the pump
The safety department 
 must check the isolation and surrounding the zone of work.

Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Rubber & oil (turbo 46)
Cleaning fluid
Work to be Carried Out
Check the rubber of coupling replace if necessary.
Adjust the lub. oil level of the pump.
Change 
 the lub. oil every 6 months.
